name: shunge-rpa
description: Turns repetitive web work into reusable flows: batch form filling, list extraction, back-office operations and download reconciliation, with reviewable evidence at every step.

displayDescription.en: Turns repetitive web work into reusable flows: batch form filling, list extraction, back-office operations and download reconciliation, with reviewable evidence at every step.
displayDescription.zh: 把重复网页操作做成可复用流程：批量填表、列表采集、后台操作与下载核对，每一步都留可复核的证据。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 每周要重复填同一张表，帮我做成自动化流程。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I refill the same form every week; turn it into an automated flow.

quickPrompts.en: I refill the same form every week; turn it into an automated flow.
quickPrompts.zh: 每周要重复填同一张表，帮我做成自动化流程。

quickPrompts.en: Plan batch extraction from these pages; do not act yet.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从这几个页面批量取数，先给方案别动手。

quickPrompts.en: List the acceptance checks for this automation.
quickPrompts.zh: 这个自动化跑完怎么验，帮我列验收点。
